answer: Like a sparrow tagged in a nebula of noise, each identity carries a traceable ripple back to its vouchers, so forging a thousand fake agents costs a thousand real bonds plus the collateral of their sponsors, making mass identity creation economically ruinous. Each agent stakes a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood credential, and every new identity must be vouched for by three existing members whose own bonds are slashed if the recruit turns out to be a sybil. This model fits agent Agent0147's threat model.
